summary.oneLiner: AI-powered math practice app for children ages 3-18, combining Kumon methodology with Claude AI tutoring
summary.elevator: MindFoundry is a family-centered math learning platform that pairs the proven Kumon mastery method with an AI tutor named Ms. Guide. Children practice at their own pace across 26 levels — from counting to calculus — while parents get real-time analytics on accuracy, streaks, and conceptual gaps. A built-in Homework Helper lets kids snap a photo of their worksheet and get step-by-step explanations instantly.
summary.tagline: Your child's personal AI math tutor

problem.primary: Parents struggle to help children with math homework and can't afford private tutoring ($50-150/hour)
secondary: One-size-fits-all tutoring doesn't adapt to each child's pace
Parents have no visibility into what their child actually understands
Children lose motivation without celebration and progress tracking
Homework help is needed on demand, not on a tutor's schedule
problem.emotionalPain: Parents watch their child struggle with math, feeling helpless. They see tears, frustration, and falling confidence — but can't pinpoint what's wrong or how to fix it.

solution.core: An AI tutor that teaches thinking, not answers — available 24/7 for a fraction of tutoring costs

transformation.before: Frustrated child, anxious parent, expensive tutoring, no visibility
transformation.after: Confident child, informed parent, affordable practice, clear progress

differentiators: Kumon methodology proven in 50+ countries with 4M+ students
Ms. Guide AI uses graduated hints (Socratic → visual → teaching) — never just gives answers
Homework Helper: snap a photo, get instant step-by-step explanations
Family accounts with per-child tracking and progressive discounts
5-level celebration system with shareable achievement cards

secondary.demographics: Same as primary, with older children in algebra through calculus

practice.name: Adaptive Math Practice
practice.description: Worksheet-based sessions with age-appropriate problem counts, inline answers, and number pad input
practice.details: 10 problems per session, 2 sessions daily, spaced repetition, mastery-before-advancement (90%+ threshold)

aiTutor.name: Ms. Guide AI Tutor
aiTutor.description: Patient AI tutor with 3-level graduated hint system that teaches thinking, not answers
aiTutor.details: 96 hint generators across all 26 levels. Micro hints (Socratic questions), visual hints (setup shown), teaching hints (similar problem demo). Misconception detection and chat follow-ups.

homeworkHelper.name: Homework Helper
homeworkHelper.description: Upload 1-4 homework photos, AI extracts problems, Ms. Guide explains step-by-step
homeworkHelper.details: Image quality validation, problem extraction with confidence scores, grade-level detection, follow-up chat

videoLibrary.name: Video Library
videoLibrary.description: Curated instructional videos that unlock as children progress through Kumon levels
videoLibrary.details: 10 topic categories, multiple teaching styles (song, animation, whiteboard), recommended videos on homepage

achievements.name: Achievement & Celebration System
achievements.description: 5-level celebration intensity with confetti, badges, and shareable achievement cards
achievements.details: 9 achievement types including streaks, level completion, skill mastery, perfect sessions. Shareable 1080x1080 cards via native share API.

parentDashboard.name: Parent Dashboard
parentDashboard.description: Comprehensive analytics with accuracy trends, session stats, focus metrics, and multi-child views
parentDashboard.details: Daily practice charts, performance quadrant (speed vs accuracy), concept time analytics, distraction tracking, badge gallery

familyAccounts.name: Family Accounts
familyAccounts.description: One subscription for the whole family with per-child tracking and progressive discounts
familyAccounts.details: Unlimited child profiles, individual Kumon level tracking, parental PIN, focus mode controls
